title: Australia
tagline: Drive the cattle north. Eat like a drover.
about: An English aristocrat and a rough drover take a herd of cattle across northern Australia on the eve of war.
cue: Serve the mains when the drive makes camp for the night.

    StartersDrover's damperBaked damper bread with a crisp cross on top, served with butter and golden syrupHow to make it60g cold butter450g self-raising flour300ml milk4 tbsp golden syrupextra butter, to serveHeat the oven to 200°C. Rub the butter into the flour until crumbly.Mix in the milk with a knife until it just comes together.Shape into a round, score a cross on top and bake until hollow when tapped.Serve with butter and golden syrup.Faraway Downs corned beef sandwichesSliced corned beef, hot mustard and mustard pickles on buttered white breadHow to make it1.5kg corned silverside1 onion1 tbsp peppercorns8 slices of white bread40g butter2 tbsp hot mustard4 tbsp mustard picklesSimmer the silverside with the onion and peppercorns.Cool the beef in its liquid.Slice thinly.Butter the bread and pile on the beef with mustard and mustard pickles.Cut into triangles.MainsCampfire beef and vegetablesBeef chuck, carrots and potatoes slow-cooked in stock until it falls apartHow to make it1kg beef chuck, diced2 tbsp vegetable oil1 onion, sliced3 carrots, chopped600g potatoes, chopped750ml beef stock1 tsp dried thyme1 tsp black pepperBrown the beef in the vegetable oil in a camp oven or heavy pot.Add the onion, carrots, potatoes, stock, thyme and pepper.Cover and cook over coals or at 160°C until the beef falls apart.Darwin crisp-skin barra with lemon myrtleDarwin in 1942, on the edge of the warHow to make itAs written, serves 4Barramundi pan-fried skin side down until crackling crisp, with lemon myrtle butter, a mango and chilli salsa and coconut rice.Cook 300g jasmine rice with 270ml coconut milk and 250ml water.Dice 1 mango with half a red onion, 1 red chilli, coriander and lime juice.Score the skin of 4 barramundi fillets, salt well and cook skin side down in a hot oiled pan, pressing flat, for 5 minutes, then flip for 1 minute.Melt 60g butter with 1 tsp dried lemon myrtle and a squeeze of lemon and spoon over.SweetsWattleseed pavlovaMeringue with ground wattleseed, whipped cream, mango and passionfruitHow to make it4 egg whites220g caster sugar1 tsp cornflour1 tsp ground wattleseed300ml thickened cream, whipped1 mango, sliced3 passionfruits, pulpHeat the oven to 120°C. Whisk the egg whites to stiff peaks, then add the sugar a spoon at a time until glossy.Fold in the cornflour and wattleseed and shape on baking paper.Bake for 90 minutes.Cool in the oven.Top with cream, mango and passionfruit.DrinksDrover's rum and ginger beer billy punchCold black tea, dark rum, lime and ginger beer in a big pot, ladled into mugsHow to make it400ml strong black tea240ml dark rum4 limes, juiced3 tbsp brown sugar6 cups ice750ml cold ginger beermint leaves, to serve1 lime, cut into wedgesBrew the tea and chill.Mix the tea with the rum, lime juice and sugar, stirring to dissolve.Add plenty of ice and top with ginger beer.Ladle into mugs with a lime wedge and mint. Leave out the rum for a booze free pot.
